WHITE REGENT DIAMOND 75ml

Ibraq

350 MAD

White Regent Diamond tells a story of silent grandeur, born from the depths of velvety luxury and the brilliance of a precious diamond. A fragrance that shines quietly, like a breath of velvet, leaving a lasting and timeless impression, just like a diamond. Its story begins with enchanting notes of tea and aromatic herbs, gracefully unfolding into a royal embrace of patchouli and vanilla, creating a regal olfactory masterpiece unlike any other. Size: 150 mL Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Fig, Cardamom, Tea, Sandalwood Heart Notes: Iris, Vetiver Herbs Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Vanilla
